# Polydocks: The Agentic Dock Knowledge Workspace
> Autonomous mastery platform & persistent tool dock built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon.

## System Overview
Polydocks is an agent-native operating environment. There is no chat sprawl and no infinite canvas.
The UI is the Agentic Dock: a control surface pinned to the screen where every capability is a dock plugin.
Topics are organized as physical cities on disk in `workspace/<city-id>/`.

## API Endpoints for Coding Agents & LLMs
- `POST /api/agent`: Stream tool-calling agent runs via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Model: `muse-spark-1.3`.
- `POST /api/mcp`: Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC endpoint for agentic tools and workspace resources.
- `GET /api/health`: Check model connectivity, TinyFish status, and SQLite engine.
- `GET /api/cities`: List all explored cities and regions on the world map.
- `GET /api/cities/:id`: Get full city context, notes, and installed dock plugins.
- `GET /api/cities/:id/feed`: Retrieve curated research feed (papers, videos, tutorials) generated by TinyFish.
- `POST /api/cities/:id/feed/refresh`: Trigger automated research on the city's topic.

## Workspace Layout (POSIX First)
- `workspace/<city-id>/city.json`: Meta attributes, level, tags.
- `workspace/<city-id>/workspace.json`: Active dock tabs and open sources.
- `workspace/<city-id>/feed.json`: Curated research feed.
- `workspace/<city-id>/notes/*.md`: Plain markdown notes.
- `workspace/<city-id>/sources/*.json`: Raw fetched documents.
- `workspace/<city-id>/tabs/<tab-id>/`: Synthesized dynamic dock tools (index.html + manifest.json).

## MCP Server Connection
Connect your MCP client (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity) to:
- HTTP JSON-RPC URL: `http://localhost:3000/api/mcp`
- Tools exposed: `list_cities`, `get_city_workspace`, `create_city_note`, `synthesize_dock_plugin`, `run_tinyfish_research`.
